name: Kelp forest
notes: Cool rocky coasts with kelp canopies offshore: shoreline carries salt-spray cushions, rockweed and coastal scrub; underwater giant kelp, bull kelp and Laminaria form the forest with understory red/brown algae. Drawn on California/Pacific NW, Tasmania/NZ, Chile and North Atlantic (Norway, Scotland); underwater species flagged.

canopy.name: Giant kelp
canopy.source: underwater — Macrocystis pyrifera, California, Chile, S Africa, Tasmania/NZ rocky bottom 5-30 m, fronds to 45 m reaching the surface — Wikipedia

canopy.name: Bull kelp
canopy.source: underwater — Nereocystis luetkeana, Alaska to California rocky shallows, single stipe with float bulb 10-30 m — Wikipedia

canopy.name: Oarweed
canopy.source: underwater — Laminaria digitata (L. hyperborea deeper), N Atlantic rocky subtidal, fingered blade 1-3 m — Wikipedia

canopy.name: Southern bull kelp
canopy.source: underwater — Durvillaea antarctica, Chile, NZ and subantarctic exposed rocky shores, thick honeycombed fronds 3-10 m — Wikipedia

shrub.name: Coyote brush
shrub.source: Baccharis pilularis, California coastal bluffs above kelp coast, evergreen scrub 0.5-3 m — Wikipedia

shrub.name: Salal
shrub.source: Gaultheria shallon, Pacific NW headlands, evergreen shrub 0.5-2 m — Wikipedia

shrub.name: Coastal heather
shrub.source: Calluna vulgaris, N Atlantic clifftop heath (Scotland, Norway), purple-flowered dwarf shrub 20-60 cm — Wikipedia

shrub.name: Sea blite bush
shrub.source: Suaeda taxifolia, S California coastal bluffs and salt marsh edge, grey-green fleshy shrub 0.5-1.5 m — Calflora

ground.name: Thrift
ground.source: Armeria maritima, N Hemisphere sea cliffs above kelp coasts, pink cushions 5-30 cm — Wikipedia

ground.name: Rockweed
ground.source: Fucus distichus, N Pacific and N Atlantic intertidal rock at the kelp-forest shoreline, olive rockweed 10-40 cm — Wikipedia

ground.name: Surfgrass
ground.source: Phyllospadix scouleri, Pacific coast Alaska-Baja, seagrass on wave-exposed intertidal rock, bright-green ribbons 30-100 cm — Wikipedia

ground.name: Sea palm
ground.source: Postelsia palmaeformis, British Columbia to California surf-exposed rocks, miniature palm-like kelp 30-60 cm — Wikipedia

ground.name: Coralline alga
ground.source: underwater — Corallina officinalis, N Atlantic and N Pacific kelp understory and pools, pink jointed calcified turf 3-12 cm — Wikipedia
